name: OAuth Login Setup Wizard
description: Setup wizard for Kakao and Google login in a Flutter app, from console setup to CI/CD

changes: Kakao step matches the 2026 Kakao Developers console, checked end to end with a real app and a real Kakao login on iOS (projectops#156)
Android and iOS are registered on the Native App Key's own page; key hashes go one per field with the + button, not one per line
Kakao Login is turned on under Kakao Login > General; an app that reads only the user ID needs no consent item
Business and individual developers: email as a required consent item needs a Biz app, and how each can get one
CI/CD step: the templates now restore google-services.json and GoogleService-Info.plist with .github/scripts/firebase_config_files.py (projectops#785), so you only register the two secrets
Older installs are told to update the templates with npx projectops; a manual iOS step remains only as a fallback and skips when the secret is empty
Removed the outdated note that Android workflows overwrite google-services.json when the secret is empty
First release (projectops#156): Kakao and Google, pick one or both; only the steps you need are shown
Signing-key step: which key signs which build, keytool commands per OS, Kakao key hash computed in the browser from the SHA-1
Kakao step: Native App Key, Android key hashes, iOS bundle ID, Kakao Login and consent items
Google step: Firebase or Google Cloud route; reads client IDs from google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist and checks package, bundle ID and registered SHA-1s
Secrets, CI/CD and .gitignore steps reuse the existing GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON secret and add GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST for the two iOS workflows
oauth-wizard.py patches AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist idempotently (detect, fingerprints, key-hash, setup with --dry-run)
English by default with a Korean toggle; generated files and commands are identical in both languages
